title: Cheat sheet
description: content/<field>/courses/<course-id>/cheatsheet.json (optional): the formulas the course derives or uses, grouped, each with one line on when to reach for it. Shown as a tool in the lesson. Checked by tools/validate_courses.py, which also checks that `lesson` is one of the course's lessons and that the Markdown is safe. The learner's own notes are not here: they stay on the device.

formula.description: Markdown with KaTeX, in the course's own notation.

when.description: One sentence: when to reach for it.

cue.description: Optional. What the review card shows on its front besides `name`: the recall prompt, in Markdown. It must say WHAT to recall without containing the formula (or the line that nearly states it); `when` moves to the back. The cheat sheet tool itself does not show it.

lesson.description: The lesson that derives it (an id in course.json).
